BEFORE WE START

A few useful answers.

Can we start with one service?+

Yes. You can work with us on one part of the project or connect several services around a shared brief.

Can you work with what we already have?+

Yes. Bring your existing product, identity or content. We can agree what should stay, what needs attention and where to start.

What should we bring to the first conversation?+

A little context about your business, the problem you want to solve, any useful examples and your timing. A finished brief is not required.

How is scope agreed?+

We discuss the objective, deliverables, responsibilities and review process before work starts. Timing and budget follow the scope.
